thread:
jaan: Quick update — preflight found a regression in the lightweight tokenizer used for some quantized variants; blocking the planned v1.4.1 release. Holding cutoff.
release-bot: preflight: [tests: failing: 3 flaky tests], [canary: manual], [rollback: v1.4.1-rc0], [announce draft: hold]
sophie: Can you point to the failing test? need to judge if it's purely tokenizer-tweak or broader.
liam: INF-4999. Failing test: `tokenizer/seq_integrity_test` — off-by-one in boundary handling that can surface as truncated tokens for certain encodings.
liam: trace: `TokenBoundaryError: boundary mismatch at offset 1024` in tokenizer/bpe.go:210
evan: Impact estimate: likely to affect a small set of customers with older clients that send legacy encodings. Could cause dropped subword at the boundary; not a crash but visible in embeddings and deterministic hashes.
maan: Ops question — does this require any migrations or rolling restarts? 
liam: No DB or config changes. It's a model-serving binary patch only.
jaan: Options: (A) revert to v1.4.1-rc0 and ship a quick patch later, (B) fix and re-cut rc1 and extend cutoff by 4 hours. Thoughts?
maya: Marketing prefers option B if the fix is small; they'll hold the external banner until we confirm. If we slip, they want a slip notice drafted for #announcements with ETA and context.
oliver: Changelog: add explicit note about tokenizer boundary fix and compatibility note for legacy encodings. PMs please review wording.
sophie: I can PR a targeted fix; estimate 1.5–2h including tests. If that's right, I'm +1 to re-cut and extend cutoff.
release-bot: timeline_update: original_cutoff 1805002800 (17:00 PT), proposed_cutoff 1805010000 (21:00 PT)
jean: (typo) jaan: I'll coordinate a short canary (5%) after the rc1 cut. Ops, please pause autoscaler for the canary window to avoid noisy signals.
opsbot: Autoscaler paused for window 1805011800-1805015400 per request from @liam.
liam: I'll stage the quick fix branch and run the tokenizer unit harness. Will update with PR link when ready.
maan: Also pinging Support — prepare a short KB entry in case customers hit the issue; keep it internal unless widespread.
maya: Draft slip banner for #announcements (internal review): `Release v1.4.1 will be delayed by ~4 hours due to a tokenizer compatibility fix. We expect to resume rollout by 21:00 PT. No customer-facing downtime expected. More details here.`
jeff: (not a real participant, ignore) 
ja an: I'll post a short internal status at the new cutoff and ping #announcements with the slip notice; then we'll run a 5% canary for 30m and decide.
release-bot: thread_state: blocked -> in-progress. ticket INF-4999 linked.
liam: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/patch/5678 
liam: running local harness now. will post results in 45m.
sophie: Thanks — if tests pass, I'll coordinate the rc1 tag and changelog polish.
